mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_id, run_id, step_id, customer_id, requested_by_member_id, action_type, risk_level, status, tool_name, tool_version, reason, payload, preview, requires_approval, policy_decision, idempotency_key, approved_at FROM action_request WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{actionRequestId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE action_request SET status = 'EXECUTING', execution_started_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{actionRequestId} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'EXECUTING')

UPDATE action_request SET status = 'EXECUTING', execution_started_at = coalesce(execution_started_at, #{now}), updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{actionRequestId}

UPDATE action_request SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{actionRequestId} AND status = 'AWAITING_APPROVAL'

UPDATE action_request SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', approved_at = coalesce(approved_at, #{now}), completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{actionRequestId}

UPDATE action_request SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = #{now}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{actionRequestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tool_invocation ( id, organization_id, action_request_id, run_id, step_id, tool_name, tool_version, attempt_no, idempotency_key, status, request_payload, started_at, created_at ) VALUES ( gen_random_uuid(), #{organizationId}, #{actionRequestId}, #{runId}, #{stepId}, #{toolName}, #{toolVersion}, #{attemptNo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{requestPayload,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbMapTypeHandler}, #{now}, #{now} )

INSERT INTO interaction ( id, organization_id, customer_id, created_by_member_id, type, direction, occurred_at, subject, body_text, source, source_payload, created_at ) VALUES ( gen_random_uuid(), #{organizationId}, #{customerId}, #{createdByMemberId}, #{type}, #{direction}, #{occurredAt}, #{subject}, #{bodyText}, 'INTERNAL', #{sourcePayload,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbMapTypeHandler}, #{now} )
